title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Demurrage Day Rates for Dry-Class Equipment
content:
Rate card for demurrage days billed at dry-class rates under the Demurrage and Detention Free Time products. Each figure is in US dollars and is charged once per container for each chargeable demurrage day that falls in the slab shown.

| Product | Slab 1 day | Slab 2 day | Slab 3 day | Slab 4 day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 210.00 | 290.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 68.00 | 112.00 | 168.00 | 232.00 |

The five tariff, extension and combined products share one dry demurrage scale; the contract product has its own, lower scale.

Hypothetical illustration, before any uplift: two dry demurrage days in slab 2 under AHL Combined Free Time 14 come to 140.00 twice, a total of 280.00; the same two days under AHL Contract Free Time 30 come to 224.00.
